step1.name: Heat-set insert pull-out (Fable C1 / #2 M4)
passes: M3 (Ø4.0 × 4.0 and × 6): mean ≥ 1.0 kN, lowest of 3 ≥ 0.8 kN (the 1.0 kN the repo assumed: rnd/joints.py, roll_inline.md). For scale: an M3 tightened to 0.5 N·m already pulls ≈ 833 N
M4 (Ø5.6 × 5.7 and × 8): mean ≥ 1.5 kN, lowest ≥ 1.2 kN (2 × the 750 N M4 preload the repo tightens to, cartridge_m.FLANGE_LOAD, so a seat cap or strap can take its working load on top)
torque-out: no insert spins below 2 × its build torque (M3 1.0 N·m, M4 1.2 N·m)
M5 (Ø6.4 × 10, belt-roll fallback only, roll.PINCH): ≥ 3.0 kN; print it only if `PIP_ROLL_DRIVE=belt` comes back

step1.name: Bolted 4-ear cartridge flange (D24 v2, Neon #2 F2)
passes: fresh, 4 × ISO 4762 M4 × 12 at 0.6 N·m (≈ 750 N each): no slip at **16.5 N·m** (1.5 × the 11 N·m GIM6010 peak), 10 × each way, 1 min each (a witness line across flange and plate moves ≤ 0.1 mm at r 48)
fresh breakaway torque recorded → μ = T_slip / (4 × 0.75 kN × r 48 mm); the model's 43 N·m is μ 0.3 (the 50 kg luggage scale at r 100 reaches 49 N·m; if it does not slip, record > 49)
tipping: no 0.05 mm feeler enters at any ear under **16.1 N·m** bending (1.5 × the 10.7 N·m direct-stage case, 3 g + the belt pull on the motor bearing; the model opens at 33 N·m with 30 % preload)
after 72 h at 50 °C on the P2S bed (preload only): no slip at **13 N·m** (the 30 %-retained friction the flange rows assume, 1.18 × the peak); each ear screw's breakaway torque recorded
one spare ear torqued to 1.2 N·m (2 × the preload): the nut does not pull into its pocket, the pocket floor does not crack

step1.name: D26 drive stub on the GIM output (Fable #2 M3)
passes: (a) tilt stiffness of the output (secant 0 → 9.8 N·m, the housing's own tilt subtracted) **≤ 18 kN·m/rad** (≈ 5.4 N·m per arcmin), i.e. ≥ 1.8′ of tilt at 9.8 N·m (3.2 mm of spot travel on the optical lever at 3 m; 11 µm on a dial at r 20): then the hinged design stands (fatigue 3.13×). Stiffer: the 0.15 mm swap offset drives the stub to 0.56× (fully rigid), so quote the overhung pinion instead (belts.py STUB_SUPPORT_RULE). Hand model, ESTIMATE
(a) PCD, pilot Ø and thread depth read to ± 0.1 mm (C9 disc + calipers) into cartridge_m.MOTOR['out_pcd'] and belt_stage.STUB; the thread depth ≥ 4 mm for M3 × 6 under a 1.8 mm counterbore

(b) on the dummy output: no slip (witness ≤ 0.05 mm at r 17) at **16.5 N·m**, 10 × each way, with a **360 N** radial pull at the flange (the motor bearing's share of the 1158 N shaft load at the peak, belts.md hinged); breakaway of each screw ≥ its build torque after (the model holds 27.2 N·m: μ 0.2 × 8 × 1.0 kN × r 17, 2.47×)
(c) 1b, on the rig: the drive at its 11 N·m peak against the hard stop, 10 ×: no slip (witness mark)

load_chain.name: Creep coefficient φ of a print-clamped tube (Neon #3, C1 'before' rows)
passes: tube r 11–20 × 69.6 (the pitch tube's wall) bare on an M8 + Belleville-free steel washers at 8.8 MPa (≈ 7.7 kN, the wave-3 stress), 1000 h at 40 °C (the P2S bed + a box): the squeeze grows by ≤ 2.0 × its elastic part extrapolated to 2 × 10⁴ h (Findley t^n fit of the 1, 10, 100, 1000 h readings) → φ ≤ 2.0
φ ≤ 1.0 (the nominal) lets the C1 'before' rows and the V-band's creep term relax; φ > 2.0 fails the design value: the W21 disc stack is resized

load_chain.name: Sleeved tie joints: moment to gap (C1 pitch + yaw ties, the bone tie)
passes: pitch hub ↔ tube: no gap (≤ 5 µm at the tension edge) at **30 N·m** (the worst service row), gap onset ≥ 39 N·m (0.7 × the model's 56 N·m at the life preload); yaw flange ↔ tube: no gap (≤ 5 µm at the tension edge) at **33 N·m** (the worst service row), gap onset ≥ 37 N·m (0.7 × the model's 54 N·m at the life preload); bone ↔ yaw flange: no gap (≤ 5 µm at the tension edge) at **32 N·m** (the worst service row), gap onset ≥ 105 N·m (0.7 × the model's 151 N·m at the life preload)
after 72 h at 50 °C under the preload alone, the same no-gap moment within 10 % and each nut's breakaway ≥ its build torque

load_chain.name: Tapped M3 threads in the 7075 flange (yaw tie, bone studs)
passes: yaw tie (8.3 mm engaged, ISO 4762 12.9): strip ≥ **3.6 kN** (1.5 × the 2.38 kN fault bolt force; model 14.3)
bone studs (3.4 mm tapped through the recess floor, DIN 976 10.9 + Loctite 270): strip ≥ **3.0 kN** (1.5 × 1.97; model 4.9), and the stud does not turn at 2 × its 0.8 N·m nut torque after 24 h cure

load_chain.name: R17 front stop: 7075 dog on its block (W16c)
passes: static: the dog on its block at **3.05 kN** (the 102.9 N·m stall at r 33.75, one dog) for 10 s: no yield (dial ≤ 0.01 mm set), no crack

100 hits at the drive limit (1.04 kN, 35.1 N·m; a 1 kg drop weight from the height that gives the stop's impact energy, ESTIMATE): dent ≤ 0.05 mm on either face, the hard anodise unbroken (no bright metal under 10× loupe)

load_chain.name: Inline roll output dowels: slip torque (Neon 6a)
passes: the 7075 adapter on the output, 3 × Ø4 dowels bonded in situ + 3 × M4 × 10 csk: no slip (witness ≤ 0.02 mm at r 30) at **103 N·m** (the stall; model 106 N·m = 1.03×), 10 × each way; dry dowels recorded for comparison (model 69 N·m)

load_chain.name: Elbow core bond: 6061 tube in the printed shaft (Neon #2 finding 7)
passes: torque-out of the 16 mm bond ≥ **68 N·m** (3 MPa: the fault row's 62.7 N·m elbow peak, 86% in the core, needs 2.37 MPa under the 40T)
sustained: 23 N·m (1 MPa) held 72 h at 50 °C: no rotation (witness line ≤ 0.1 mm at r 20)
the failure is cohesive in the print or the adhesive, not a clean peel off the abraded bore (else: a knurled core, or the D-flat key)

load_chain.name: Arm detach V-band clamp on the printed ferrules (D29 + W21 disc stack)
passes: stack to its stop: T-bolt **410 N** (stack height on the calibration curve, ± 10 %); the face (outer land r 41–45.5) shows no gap at the rim (dial, ≤ 5 µm) up to **26.7 N·m** (the hug row × 1.5), fresh and after 72 h at 50 °C (the model keeps 1.39 kN, gap at 29 N·m)
stack height after the hold: ≥ the stop minus 0.5 mm (the creep budget of the 2.7 mm stroke)
fault: 183 N·m for 10 s (the stall row): no disengagement, no lip crack, the faces re-close
as designed (D29 wing nut, no stack, full face): record the gap moment fresh at a light hand and after the hold (the model: 13 N·m fresh, ≈ 0 after)
a timed two-arm join with the lever nut ≤ 30 s (R3)
